title: Create a Liquid Widget Without Writing a Module | Orchard Core
description:
A footer note, a banner or a snippet of HTML, CSS or JavaScript that an editor maintains does not need a module. A widget is a content type, and the Liquid part gives it a body that is written in Liquid in the admin.

This video builds one in the admin: a content type with the Liquid part and the Widget stereotype, a placement in a zone through a layer, and a Widget__LiquidWidget template that changes the markup the widget renders.

In this video:
• What a Liquid widget is, and who can edit one
• Create the content type with the Liquid part
• Make it a widget with the Widget stereotype
• Add it to a layer and publish it
• How a widget is rendered: shapes, alternates and the standard template
• Write the Widget__LiquidWidget template
• The same template in flows and themes
